raw_block.rationale: Provide an alternative component-based representation that asks the reader to keep base, overweight, and oversize charges separate for each listed bag. The helper performs the legally material higher-fee comparison and final aggregation itself.

inputs.name: ticket_price
inputs.question: What ticket price is stated for the current passenger?

inputs.name: bag_base_fees
inputs.question: For each current bag in listed order, what base checked-bag fee applies after cabin classification, route-and-cabin ordinal pricing, and complimentary treatment, using 0 for a free cabin item?

inputs.name: bag_overweight_fees
inputs.question: For each current bag in listed order, what overweight surcharge applies under the current cabin weight limit and route schedule, using 0 when none applies?

inputs.name: bag_oversize_fees
inputs.question: For each current bag in listed order, what oversize surcharge applies to its summed outside dimensions under the current route schedule, using 0 when none applies?

skill.intent: Calculate the exact ticket-plus-fees total from separately itemized base, overweight, and oversize charges for every current bag.

outputs.description: Exact integer ticket price plus all current base and excess baggage fees.
outputs.name: answer

fields.name: bag_base_fees
fields.question: What base checked-bag fee belongs to each listed bag, with zero for permitted cabin items?

fields.name: bag_overweight_fees
fields.question: What overweight surcharge belongs to each listed bag, with zero when the current weight limit is not exceeded?

fields.name: bag_oversize_fees
fields.question: What oversize surcharge belongs to each listed bag after summing its outside dimensions, with zero when no size tier applies?

reads.question: Apply the current cabin, route, ordinal, weight, and size rules separately to each listed bag and return distinct base, overweight, and oversize components without combining them.

origin.quote: All published bag fees apply at each check-in location and are base rates according to travel dates and destination; applicable taxes are not shown.

source_obligations.statement: Assign zero to permitted cabin items and otherwise assign the published route-, cabin-, and ordinal-specific checked-bag fee.

origin.quote: More than one fee may apply per bag that exceeds standard dimensions for both weight and size.

source_obligations.statement: Determine overweight and oversize components separately under the current cabin and route schedules.

origin.quote: The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.

source_obligations.statement: For each bag, add the greater of its overweight and oversize components to its base checked-bag fee, then add all bag fees to the ticket.

source_provenance.quote: You're allowed 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item in all cabins.

support.text: In some cases, you won't have to pay the fees for up to 3 bags when traveling on itineraries marketed and operated by American Airlines. If you qualify for complimentary bags based on your AAdvantage® status or oneworld® status, the benefits are based on your highest status level at time of ticketing or check-in.

1st checked bag is complimentary for:
* Eligible AAdvantage® Aviator® and Citi® / AAdvantage® cardmembers (on domestic American Airlines operated itineraries)
* AAdvantage Gold® status
* GOL Diamond Smiles members
* oneworld® Ruby

1st and 2nd checked bags are complimentary for:
* AAdvantage Platinum® status
* oneworld® Sapphire members
* Confirmed Domestic First customers
* Confirmed Business customers
* Confirmed Premium Economy customers

1st, 2nd and 3rd checked bags are complimentary for:
* Confirmed Flagship® First and Flagship® Business Plus customers
* AAdvantage Executive Platinum® status
* AAdvantage Platinum Pro® status
* oneworld® Emerald
* Active U.S. military and / or dependents with ID traveling on orders (1st - 5th bags free of charge)
* Active U.S. military with ID on personal travel

For all confirmed customers on flights to / from Australia or New Zealand:
* Dimension: 62 in / 158 cm
